description: This file defines the MyTrackerController class, a controller within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component called 'my-tracker' before rendering.

classes.name: MyTrackerController
classes.description: Controller managing the 'my-tracker' view, extends AbstractVueController to integrate with Vue.js components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component 'my-tracker' before rendering the view.
